title: Unreal Ice Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Unreal Ice Nic Salt Banana Ice delivers the creamy, smooth flavour of ripe bananas, perfectly complemented by a crisp, cooling menthol finish. This e-liquid provides a balanced blend of rich, sweet banana with a frosty exhale, offering a satisfying vape experience that’s ideal for those who enjoy dessert-like flavours with a refreshing twist. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Unreal Ice Nic Salts are perfect for use with mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape kits and pod devices. The carefully balanced formulation ensures comfortable throat hits and rich, full-bodied flavour with every puff. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, these Nicotine Salts provide rapid relief from nicotine cravings and a smoother experience compared to traditional high-strength freebase e-liquids. The Unreal Ice range from Dispergo E-Liquids brings you a collection of intensely satisfying flavours, given a fresh and frosty exhale with just the right amount of menthol added to the base. Whether you prefer fruity, menthol, or confectionary-inspired e-liquids, the Unreal Ice collection delivers exceptional flavour and unbeatable refreshment for a consistently enjoyable vape.
